name: codex-gardener
description: Promote repeated Codex task lessons at the right scope and audit their local effectiveness without telemetry.

interface.shortDescription: Promote and audit reusable knowledge locally.
interface.longDescription: Capture lessons from real Codex tasks, distinguish repository-specific knowledge from portable global knowledge, safely promote proven guidance, and audit low-sensitivity effectiveness metrics entirely on the local machine.
defaultPrompt: Review this completed task and capture reusable knowledge at the right scope.
Curate repository and global learning candidates.
Coordinate this cross-project change in the repository that owns it.
